calibrated_metric_definition: cal_uncertainty_YEAR = 1 - calibrated P(final GAIA-constrained class); calibration uses one-vs-rest isotonic regression fitted on held-out samples.
note: final_prob_YEAR is the MLP probability assigned to mlp_pred5_YEAR, the final post-GAIA-constraint class used in the land-use maps. cal_final_prob_YEAR is the corresponding one-vs-rest isotonic calibrated probability.
